items.label: Deutsche Grammophon
items.note: The divided strings move in opposite directions until their separate lines fuse into a slowly changing chord. Abbado’s Vienna Philharmonic recording places Ligeti beside Nono, Boulez and Rihm on the Wien Modern album.

items.recorded: 28–30 October 2019, St Silas the Martyr, Kentish Town, London
items.label: Hyperion
items.note: Désordre sets the right hand on white keys and the left on black, then lets their accents drift apart. Driver’s one-disc recording includes all eighteen studies, from Désordre to Canon.

items.performers: Isabelle Faust, violin; Les Siècles; François-Xavier Roth
items.recorded: September–October 2023, Maison de l’Orchestre national d’Île-de-France, Alfortville
items.label: harmonia mundi
items.note: Four ocarinas and retuned violin and viola parts disturb the orchestra’s usual tuning. Faust plays a cadenza she devised with Oscar Strasnoy.
